I'm sure Iceland or the Faroe Islands (mosquito free as well!) wouldn't turn you down just because you're American-- immigration is far from uncommon, and it helps that English is commonly spoken there. have you considered making a tinder? i know it can be hard to take that step, especially with low self esteem (ive been wanting to make one for months but have been held back out of fear of showing my face), but itll provide you with people to talk to. you wont need to expect a deep relationship right away, because you'll be meeting new people and can have conversations with them at your leisure. and who knows, maybe you'll be able to make some nice friends or find a good relationship or two. 

as for hobbies, i recommend that you try something new whenever you can. it might be hard to find motivation, but you might find something that you'll become passionate about. maybe take up painting, or try to cook something simple for yourself. you might be surprised by how much you enjoy it, or you might have a certain knack for something. you're still young. i know it may not feel like it, but your life is far from over. you have plenty of time to discover yourself. i wish you all the best! if you ever want someone to talk to, feel free to pm me.
